name: PWA OPAQUE STATUS BAR FIX
changes: Changes the iOS standalone status bar mode from black-translucent to opaque black for the admin PWA
Removes duplicate top safe-area compensation from the root mobile header and main viewport offset
Keeps viewport-fit=cover for bottom home-indicator handling while preventing the top header from rendering inside the iOS scroll-edge layer
Adds a permanent regression check that blocks black-translucent from returning to the admin PWA
notes: Single-purpose frontend/PWA rendering fix based on v16.4.11.
No Supabase migration, Edge Function, table, grant, RLS policy, Monobank, Nova Poshta or VAcleaner runtime change.
No further header typography or UX changes are included in this release.
